ns2:section.sectionText: Developing Career Portfolios for Musicians. In this course, students will create a professional portfolio of various career development pieces including a curriculum vitae, resumes, personal website, teaching philosophy, biographies, social media presence, as well as develop skills of grant writing, networking, self-recording, and interview best practices. Students will also learn about job application processes and careers beyond teaching and performing. Each week, students will engage with industry professionals from the School of Music, FAA, the University of Illinois at large, and beyond to learn about cultivating career success. *******THIS COURSE WILL MEET FOR THE FIRST EIGHT WEEKS JAN 16 - MARCH 9
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
